name: view_creep_health_bar_shows_health
description: A hurt creep's health bar shows what is left: its fill covers that share of the trough from the left, and stays inside it however the creep turns. Two billboarded quads could not (a billboard dropped the fill's scale, and the offset that kept its left end fixed was in the creep's turning frame): a Gourdling at a third of its health showed a fill nine tenths wide, under the trough (review round 2). Now one camera-facing quad draws trough and fill together. Rendered, the scenario measures the fill on screen against a frame without the bar.

steps.msg: the Gourdling is hurt, and the tower that hurt it is sold
the bar's fill is the share of health left
on screen the fill covers that share of the bar (rendered runs; a headless run has no pixels)
and the same once the creep has turned a quarter
